settings.title: Orders & delivery
settings.hint: Decide how customers order from you. Customers only see the effect: anything switched off or left empty does not appear on your market page.
settings.ordersOnHint: Visible to customers: cart and ordering on your market page.
settings.ordersOffHint: Off: your market stays visible with its products and offers, but without cart and ordering. Customers see no notice.
settings.pauseHint: No new orders for a while, e.g. when it is busy. Applies at once. Visible to customers: "Orders again from …".
settings.closedHint: No slots on these days. Visible to customers until the period is over: "Closed from … to …".
settings.slotsHint: Empty fields use the platform default. Customers only see the matching slots, never the numbers.
settings.ownDeliveryHours: Delivery times differ from the opening hours
settings.deliveryHoursHint: Deliveries happen during the opening hours (market profile).
settings.autoAcceptHint: New orders are accepted at once; you do not need to confirm each one.
settings.paymentHint: Visible to customers on the market page and in the order confirmation when they pay at handover.
settings.defaultMaxHint: Applies to new products without their own maximum.

problem.closedBoth: Please give the start and the end.
problem.closedOrder: The end is before the start.
problem.noDeliveryHours: Enter at least one delivery time or switch the option off.
problem.payment: Choose at least one payment method.

settings.boardOff: Online orders are switched off. Customers see your market but cannot order.

features.title: Features for customers
features.hint: Switch functions on and off for all customers. Anything switched off does not appear in the app and web app.
features.needsList: Takes effect only while the shopping list is on.

name.SHOPPING_LIST_MEDIA: Photograph or film the shopping list

description.SHOPPING_LIST: Customers type their list in a market and the matching products are found.
description.SHOPPING_LIST_VOICE: Voice input; recognition runs on the phone.
description.SHOPPING_LIST_MEDIA: Photos or a short video of the list, read by the AI (uses AI requests; needs the Anthropic key).
description.MERCHANT_MULTILINGUAL: Merchants fill in the market description, products and promotions in every language. Off: only in the market's language, which customers see whatever language they use.
